paragraphs.en: A school board announced that another large class would solve its financial problems. The average class size would rise from a little over thirty to almost forty, but officials argued that the change was small compared with the budget gap. Several parents disagreed. Both teachers and pupils already worked under great pressure, and a few extra children in every room could have a big effect. The proposal sounded simple because the total number of pupils remained the same. Yet the whole discussion depended on whether a crowded classroom was merely a room containing more people or a different learning environment altogether.
paragraphs.zh: 教育委员会说再增一个大班即可解决财务问题，平均班额从三十多人升到近四十，官员认为比预算缺口这是小变化。几位家长不同意，师生已有很大压力，每室多几名孩子也可能影响很大。方案看似简单，因为学生总数不变，但争论取决于：拥挤教室只是装更多人，还是已经成为不同的学习环境？

paragraphs.en: A teacher, Sam, invited the board to observe seven lessons rather than rely only on a broad annual report. At first, observers saw nothing especially alarming. Children sat quietly, and the timetable remained full. However, quietness was hardly proof that everything was going well. One pupil waited a long time for feedback, while another could seldom find a moment to ask a question. Something important happened at the level of attention: when teachers helped one child, many others received less support. This was not because teachers lacked skill, but partly because a school day had limited minutes.
paragraphs.zh: 教师山姆请委员会看七节课，而非只依靠宽泛年报。最初看不出特别异常：孩子安静坐着，课表满满。但安静几乎不能证明一切顺利。一个孩子等反馈很久，另一个很少找到提问时机。关注层面发生变化：教师帮一人时，许多人得到更少支持。这并非教师技能差，部分因为一天时间有限。

paragraphs.en: The board asked whether technology could double the amount of practice without increasing costs. Sam agreed that digital exercises could help, especially when pupils needed to repeat a small task. Yet devices could not do anything a teacher might do. A screen could check an answer but struggled to understand why a child had lost confidence. Nor was either extreme useful: claiming that technology offered nothing, or expecting it to solve everything. The depth of learning depended on the quality of explanation and on relationships, not simply on the mass of questions completed. A huge collection of exercises could still leave a student confused.
paragraphs.zh: 委员会问技术能否不增费用就让练习翻倍。山姆同意数字练习有帮助，尤其重复小任务，但设备不能做教师可能做的任何事。屏幕能核答案，却难理解孩子为何没信心。两个极端都无益：说技术毫无用处，或期待解决一切。学习深度取决于解释质量与关系，不只是做题数量；巨量练习仍可能使学生困惑。

paragraphs.en: The financial picture was indeed difficult. Half the available funds went to staff, and maintaining old buildings required an enormous sum. A lot of spending could not be reduced without consequences. Parents proposed lowering the height of the planned entrance monument and redirecting its funding to learning support. To some extent this would help, though none of the participants thought it sufficient alone. Sam asked for at least a clear comparison of alternatives. A vast budget document could hide practical choices, whereas a simple account of the costs and benefits would allow the public to participate meaningfully.
paragraphs.zh: 财务确实困难，一半可用资金付员工，旧楼维护又需巨款，许多开支削减都会有后果。家长提议降低计划入口纪念物高度，把钱转学习支持。一定程度有帮助，但无人觉得单靠这够。山姆至少要求清楚比较备选方案。庞大预算文件可能藏住实际选择，而清楚成本收益说明能让公众有效参与。

paragraphs.en: The board eventually adopted a mixed plan, keeping some classes small and providing additional assistance where needs were greatest. It was a very modest victory, and Sam knew the available time was not quite enough for too many competing demands. Perhaps no arrangement could be perfect, but the discussion had become more honest. A bit of careful observation had challenged a claim presented as obvious. Educational decisions involve numbers, yet numbers need interpretation. Knowing the degree of crowding matters less than understanding what that crowding changes for the people who must teach and learn together throughout an ordinary school day.
paragraphs.zh: 委员会最终采取混合方案：部分班保持小规模，在需求最大处增加帮助。胜利很有限，山姆知道可用时间仍不太够应付过多不同要求。也许没有完美安排，但讨论更诚实。少量认真观察质疑了号称显而易见的说法。教育决策涉及数字，数字却需解释。拥挤程度本身不如理解它怎样改变日常共同教学与学习的人们重要。
